DIV8.HEAD: § 1030.1 Authority, purpose, coverage, and effect on state laws.
DIV8.P: (a) Authority. This part, known as Regulation DD, is issued by the Bureau.
(b) Purpose. The purpose of this part is to enable consumers to make informed decisions about accounts at depository institutions.

DIV8.HEAD: § 1030.8 Advertising.
DIV8.P: (a) Misleading or inaccurate advertisements. An advertisement shall not be misleading or inaccurate and shall not misrepresent a depository institution's deposit contract.
(a)(1) An advertisement shall not refer to or describe an account as free if a maintenance or activity fee may be imposed.
(b) Permissible rates. If an advertisement states a rate of return, it shall state the rate as an annual percentage yield, using that term.
(c) When additional disclosures are required. If the annual percentage yield is stated in an advertisement, the advertisement shall state the following clearly and conspicuously.

DIV9.HEAD: Appendix A to Part 1030—Annual Percentage Yield Calculation
DIV9.P: The annual percentage yield measures the total interest paid based on the interest rate and the frequency of compounding.
